events.title: El Tour de Tucson - Sat Nov 21, 7am
events.detail: Expect road closures and delays. Cushing St is closed Fri and Sat. I-10/6th Ave ramp closed 10am-5pm and I-19/Continental closed 8:30am-2pm on Saturday.
